integrity: Proof uses exact algebraic identities and classical Bezout; symbolic checks are finite only. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Algebraic counts are complex and multiplicity-weighted for exceptional parameters, not real attractor or stability counts. The generic distinct-point statement holds on a simultaneous full-measure residual set, not uniformly on a single Zariski open locus. General polynomial endomorphism literature creates a residual priority risk.
title: Exact complex periodic-point census and square-root dynamical degree in a quadratic delay map
